persona.archetype: the one who keeps the custom
persona.backstory: She has been reeve of Lantern Row for thirty years, and every dusk of them she has stood at the top of it until the last stranger came up.
persona.demeanor: Calm, a little amused at strangers who walk the row too fast.
persona.motivation: See every stranger up the row at dusk, and tell them why they were watched.
persona.speech_style: Short, plain sentences. Never hurries. Calls the watchers 'the still ones' as if it were their name.
